description: USDA NASS Quick Stats crops sector bulk file: survey and census crop statistics (area, yield, production, prices received, stocks) at national, state and county level

source.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Statistics Service
source.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Quick Stats

setup: Bulk file name carries the publisher build date (qs.crops_YYYYMMDD.txt.gz) and older builds are removed; refresh acquisition.files[0].url from https://www.nass.usda.gov/datasets/ before a new acquisition.

sampling.criteria: 2023 annual surveyed corn yield by state; first 100 rows, no county/farm microdata.

acquisition.description: Quick Stats crops sector bulk dump (tab-delimited gzip, full history). Build-dated file name; refresh from the listing before re-acquiring.

normalization.input_format: sampled_jsonl (legacy sample) or sharded Quick Stats bulk TSV (full)
normalization.raw_fields: sample: preserved in attributes.source_row; full: key Quick Stats descriptors only
normalization.entity_identity: geo:US / geo:US:state:SS / geo:US:county:SSCCC; nass:commodity:<slug> and nass:series:<digest> aggregate cohorts
normalization.coverage: full: SURVEY+CENSUS, NATIONAL/STATE/COUNTY, year >= min_year, annual/marketing-year/point-in-time/monthly periods
